mainEntity.name: What Is the Throughput Range of a Gravity Case Packer?

acceptedAnswer.text: TRFDroppack is positioned for applications of about 20 to 500 products per minute, on medium to low throughput lines. The range is an application range, not a nominal machine speed. The rate a given line reaches depends on the package, the collation pattern, the count per case and the equipment upstream and downstream, all validated by TRF engineering.

mainEntity.name: What Is a Vertical Case Packer and When Is It the Right Fit?

acceptedAnswer.text: A vertical case packer moves the product downward into the case instead of placing it with a robot arm, which is how a gravity drop packer works. It fits when the package is flexible, the pack pattern repeats and the priority is efficiency with low mechanical complexity. TRFDroppack uses that vertical movement, which can also keep the packing station compact on a crowded floor.

mainEntity.name: Can a Case Packer Handle Frozen or IQF Products?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. TRFDroppack packs IQF product bags and frozen food bags, along with other flexible bags and pouches. TRF validates how your bag behaves in the drop under your production conditions before confirming the design. For the palletizing step in cold areas, TRFSubzero palletizes below 32°F, in frozen food and refrigerated or frozen areas.

mainEntity.name: What Is the Difference Between a Case Packer and a Case Erector?

acceptedAnswer.text: A case erector forms a flat corrugated blank into an open case; a case packer loads product into it. TRF does not sell stand-alone case erectors. TRFOnepack erects, packs and seals inside one machine.

mainEntity.name: Can Case Packing Equipment Integrate With My Existing Palletizer and Conveyors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. TRF engineers the interfaces between the packer and equipment already in your plant, and reviews existing equipment and controls before the scope is defined. TRFIntraflow brings sensors, PLC and HMI, machine communication and palletizer interfaces. The bag palletizer page covers the palletizing side of a bag line.

mainEntity.name: How Much Does a Drop Packer Cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on the package, the collation pattern, the case format and the rate, plus the integration scope around the machine. Payback comes from labor savings and throughput improvement with a less complex automation architecture, and fewer complex components also mean less to service over the life of the machine. A TRF Sales Engineer quotes each application from your line data.

mainEntity.name: Who Supplies Case Packing Equipment for Food and CPG Manufacturers in the US?

acceptedAnswer.text: TRF supplies top-load case packing equipment to food and CPG manufacturers across the United States: TRFDroppack for gravity packing of flexible packages, TRFRapidpack for high-mix robotic packing and TRFOnepack for integrated erecting, packing and sealing. TRF also supplies the conveying and palletizing around them, so one partner answers for the whole end of line, from the bagger discharge to the finished pallet.
